explanation: Read the edge legend, locate the unique seed, and paint Chebyshev rings in the drawing canvas. Any ring that extends beyond that canvas changes its own legend swatch to the divider gray. This geometric rule applies uniformly; seed-column alignment is not a rule. Emitted programs work directly in visible D4 coordinates and use the remapped palette.
constructor_fix: Random generation previously omitted the gray swatch and used last=5 only to reproduce canonical train[0]. The corrected constructor keeps the exact same input distribution, marks all clipped rings, and ignores the obsolete last label override. Canonical validate() remains byte-for-byte equivalent as JSON.
evidence: Independent atlas notes and solver explicitly state clipping-to-gray; snapshots, URLs and SHA256 are in label-review/sources.json. All canonical examples agree. No matching official issue/PR found by saved GitHub issue searches; this is independent third-party evidence plus original fixture support, not upstream approval.
validation: Proposed-copy audit: 1000 unique inputs unchanged, 320 generated outputs corrected, 8000 D4 checks,16 original fixture variants; independent coordinate-perimeter oracle. Live constructor standard audit and seven focused tests saved separately.
limitations: Canonical examples do not uniquely prove every rule. The clipping interpretation is geometrically coherent and independently documented; it is substantially better supported than the previous seed-column exception. No fixture labels/policy were changed.
